name: Yujie Zhu
weekly_overview: This week, I completed the MIT course and shifted my main focus to project work. For the Provider Exclusion project, the web interface has been built, and I began expanding the exclusion data coverage to include California, Illinois, and New York State.

progress: Continued working on the Provider Exclusion project. The web interface is now in place. I added New York State and California provider exclusion data and am currently working to locate a suitable Illinois exclusion data source

next_steps: Clean and standardize the state exclusion datasets, load them into the database, and integrate them with the web interface so users can search the combined provider exclusion data.
